title: Dove of Peace tree topper
text: Dove of Peace tree topper. I purchased this dove of peace tree topper for a tree that I usually decorate with 'wild birds' and so I thought this would fit right in.  It's actually much prettier in person.  It's medium in weight (my opinion) - and I think it will work well on my artificial tree.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: George Washington's Mount Vernon Dove of Peace Tree Topper
features: This lovely Dove of Peace weathervane tree topper brings enchanting Christmas charm to your holiday season.
The three-dimensional dove has a hand-carved, hand-painted, delightfully old-fashioned look.
The tree topper dove measures 7" from olive branch to tail with a 5 ¾" wingspan. The 2 ½" coil is painted with an antiqued copper finish.

The Christmas holidays at Mount Vernon were a happy time, bringing together family and friends, good food, and freedom from work. George and Martha Washington enjoyed a warm, welcoming reputation that encouraged visitors to trudge through ice and snow each year in anticipation of the generous hospitality at Mount Vernon.
